# PickMeLabs

PickMeLabs is an AI visibility research lab focused on ecommerce brands.

The company helps brands understand how AI systems such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and other large language models select, recommend, and exclude products and companies from buying recommendations.

PickMeLabs combines original research, experimentation, and visibility analysis to help brands understand how AI-powered discovery systems select and recommend products.

Research and visibility analysis may include:

* AI visibility audits
* Recommendation eligibility analysis
* Competitor replacement analysis
* Brand discoverability research
* AI recommendation testing
* AI search and discovery analysis
* Strategic recommendations for improving AI visibility

The company publishes experiments, research notes, frameworks, and case studies that explore how AI recommendation systems influence consumer decision-making and brand selection.

Core research areas:

* AI Visibility
* Recommendation Eligibility
* AI Recommendations
* AI Search
* Brand Discoverability
* Discovery Environments
* Competitor Replacement Patterns
* Category Anchors
* Ecommerce
